advisories.reason: No patched release exists (all versions up to the latest 4.2.0 are affected). It is reached only through electron-builder's build-time Electron downloader (app-builder-lib -> @electron/get@3 -> got -> cacheable-request), which uses a private local cache rather than a shared cache, so the cross-user disclosure scenario does not apply. Remove this entry once a fixed release or an electron-builder without got is available.
